main_text.p: lominum & famulum, inter principem & subditos. Obligatio Acquisita & Voluntaria, quæ & Civilis (per synecdochen speciei dicitur) & Justitia, quia justum est aut quod quis voluntate sua fecit eo eneatur[?]; est quâ astringimur ad aliud officium alteri præstandum, quod debemus ex condicto, virtute alicujus voluntarii actus proprii. Talis est illa obligatio, quæ ex promissis, votis, juramentis, fœderibus, aliisque humanis constitutibus[?] & conventionibus oritur. Si cui ergo Juramentum suscipiendum deferatur, continens aliquid quod obligationi priori, sive naturali sive adquisitæ adversatur, vel si adversetur officio quod parenti debetur aut principi; vel si repugnet ei quod ante licitè juratum fuit, vel promissum, ejusmodi juramentum non potest a quoquā salvā conscientiā vel præstari, vel præstitum adimpleri. Qui utrumvis fecerit, pejeraverit.
main_text.head: SECT. XII.
main_text.p: Sequitur Hypothesis quarta, quæ est ex se evidens, ut sit Regula juris, nec probatione indigeat. l. 185. F. de divers. reg.{b}Rei impossibilis illa est Obligatio. Extenditur autem ad

page.notes: The first word of the page is cut off at the left edge; "lominum" is kept as a fragment. "eneatur" at the start of a line is partly cut off, so the first letter is doubtful. "constitutibus" is read from a hyphenated line break and is doubtful. The marginal note is partly obscured; "F." and "reg." are doubtful. The catchword "omne" is partly cut off and marked doubtful. The printed text reads "illa est Obligatio" after "Rei impossibilis"; it is transcribed as printed.
